rule: One owner carries each PR through merge.
sentence: One owner carries each PR from build to merge, following pstack autopilot-full.

rule: The verifier must PASS on the current head before merge.
sentence: Never merge without the verifier's PASS on the current head.

rule: At most five tickets in flight per agent label; ship one before starting another.
sentence: Keep at most 5 tickets in flight per agent label; at 5, ship one before starting another Todo ticket.

rule: At most five open PRs per agent; park extras and return their cards to Todo.
sentence: Keep at most 5 open PRs per agent; park extras and move their cards back to Todo.

rule: The repo-wide cap is ten open PRs.
sentence: The repo-wide cap is 10 open PRs; above it, finish existing PRs instead of opening another.

rule: Within an hour, give a workerless PR a worker or park it and return its card to Todo.
sentence: A PR without a live worker gets one within the hour, or is parked with its card back in Todo.

rule: An owned PR without a live worker blocks new work.
sentence: Never start new work while you own a PR with no live worker; restore its worker or park it first.
